question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Envisage
solution:
The correct answer is **'****Imagine.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the word 'Envisage' is to think of something as being possible in the future; to imagine.

 
 
• Word 'Envisage' का अर्थ भविष्‍य में संभावित स्थिति के विषय में सोचना; कल्‍पना करना।
 
 
 
• Let us discuss the meanings of the given options:
 
 
• Imagine: to see, hear or think something that is not true or does not exist; suppose or assume. (असत्‍य और अस्‍तित्‍वहीन वस्‍तुओं को देखना, सुनना और उनके विषय में सोचना या कल्‍पना करना)
 
• Ridicule: to behave in a manner that is intended to make somebody/something appear silly. (किसी की खिल्‍ली उड़ाने वाली निर्लज्ज हँसी या आचरण)
 
• Describe: to say what somebody/something is like, or what happened. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु या घटना का वर्णन करना)
 
• Deceive: to try to make somebody believe something that is not true. (बहकाना, भ्रमित करना​)
 
 
 
• Therefore, the word which is synonymous with the given word is 'Imagine.'
